description: Delete ONE AI package resource of a video in one language (eBook, mind map or quiz) — cannot be undone: its content, PDF, images and the published file are removed, also for legacy resources. Same as the dashboard's Remove. Refused while it is still generating (checked before deleting; if that check fails nothing is deleted). Other languages and resources stay. To remove a failed generation card use panda_delete_ai_workflow.

lang.description: Language of the resource to delete, e.g. 'en'

name: panda_delete_ai_resource
title: Delete AI Resource
